propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) after create_issue succeeds causes dispatch_one to delete the freshly created Jira issue, destroying recoverable work

The write-ahead binding recorded at dispatch_one.py:307-308 is persisted before identity writes but rollback never unbinds it, leaving a keyed-pending entry pointing at a deleted issue that permanently blocks retry

The identity-write failure branch is effectively dead code on Cloud (labels field on screens and set_entity_property bypassing screens) but latent in self-hosted DC instances with customized Create/Edit screens

The recovery path recover_pending's keyed branch already exists to retro-attach labels and entity properties deterministically without search, making the delete rollback redundant with rebar's own recovery machinery
Jira's screen-configuration error message is misleading in roughly half of cases (genuine screen absence, workflow permission denial, or malformed values), requiring operator-facing clarification
The fix must preserve the keyed-pending binding state for retro-attach recovery and declare labels as a required Create/Edit screen field rather than attempting createmeta pre-flight discovery
